name: pg-control
description: Positive and negative controls: transactions written directly against node-postgres. `correct` checks PostgreSQL's reply to COMMIT and reports a COMMIT error as a failure; `unsafe` deliberately gets both wrong. Used to show that the runner passes a known-good implementation and detects a known-bad one.

modes.description: Positive control: reads the command tag of PostgreSQL's reply to COMMIT, reports a COMMIT error as a failure, and discards a connection whose ROLLBACK failed.
Negative control: ignores the command tag of the reply to COMMIT, reports any COMMIT error as a rollback, and returns a connection whose ROLLBACK failed to its pool as it is.

unsupported.TX-04.independent-inner: The control implements no propagation modes, so it has no API that promises an independent inner transaction.
